reason: Only adds a private _hours helper in the handlers; layering, injection and encapsulation match the intended architecture.
api/handlers.py imports Slot from the domain and constructs it directly instead of talking to the application only.
ReminderService.run_for imports OutboxNotifier from adapters inside the application layer and replaces the injected notifier with it.
The book handler calls service._appointments.on_day(day), reaching the store through an object reachable from the service.
BookingService.cancel ignores the injected policy and builds LateCancellationFee(24, 30) itself, importing it from domain.policies.
